Gate 3 follows 's capture-map location convention: `docs/dev/design/-captures.json` is a list of checked
capture records. Each record has `image` (a PNG basename from `app-screenshots/edi`), `sha256` (the reviewed bytes),
and `checks` (an object mapping owner idea numbers, as strings, to concrete visual observations). Together the checks
cover ideas 1 through 27, using final feedback for withdrawn or replaced requests. Each image has its own checks.
The images are regression pins. Their correctness is checked against the owner's ideas, with independent review of
those observations; image similarity alone does not establish correctness.

The tests lane additionally pins reviewed PNG hashes and their exact observations in the hidden capture gate,
